## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the user-visible problem and what changes.

## Validation

Describe meaningful tests, native checks and remaining limits. Distinguish agent-operated checks from independent human testing.

## Attribution and AI assistance

Credit new dependencies/copied code and licenses. Disclose material AI assistance, the tool and what you reviewed.

## Checklist

- [ ] Focused change; originals and existing outputs stay protected.
- [ ] Relevant build/tests pass; documentation updated.
- [ ] No production keys, game data, secrets or personal logs included.
- [ ] Third-party notices retained and new provenance documented.
